title: Praxeophysics Protocol — Core Architecture, Dynamic Boundary Generative Model & Reference Specification v4.2.0
description: Domain-neutral core architecture, Dynamic Boundary Generative Model (Prior-Precision-Load state parameterization and Allowable Tolerance Radius), Inverse Precision Inference, Plausible Deniability pooling, and TypeScript reference implementation of the Praxeophysics Protocol v4.2.0. This release is a direct mathematical formalization and derivative improvement of the pre-existing Prior IP baseline (Praxeophysics Protocol Baseline Specification v4.0.0, finalized and timestamped 2026-08-31).
